payload.title: Berge-Fulkerson bounded star pivot Fano and literal-input archive
payload.body:
# Berge-Fulkerson bounded star pivot Fano and literal-input archive

43 exact original files, including 19 code sources. This artifact-check REVIEW preserves source/input provenance and records the precise reproduction boundaries around the existing indexed RESULT. It is inconclusive about mathematical validity; no research code was executed.

Four bounded star/pivot, Fano, literal-row and order-11 families retain local modules and fixed inputs. NetworkX and geng are external runtime dependencies. The JSON-prefix-plus-tail omen-run file and certificate-bound SPEC are exact original bytes. Historical countermodels do not establish unrestricted host/phase conclusions; the 24.6MB note102 input and unrelated SMT fixture families are outside this batch.

Raw code, fixtures, checksum-bound specifications, JSON prefixes/tails and expected records are preserved without banners or reformatting. Scientific and licence declarations live in sidecars. A file named certificate, a stored PASS or a published algorithm is not new independent proof acceptance.

Li Hongmin is the authorized human contributor; original drafting/checking was AI-assisted, with source-model identity not independently reconstructed. Codex performed static archival review and packaging. Own code Apache-2.0; original text/data CC BY 4.0; cited third-party passages retain source rights.
